title: PowerPoint: Copilot for creating and editing presentations in GCC
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap scope, licence requirement and licence-assignment controls are supported, and the conflicting GCC availability descriptions are reported rather than resolved by assumption. The summary should explicitly limit its missing-switch statement to a feature-specific switch, since Microsoft documents broader privacy controls that affect Copilot in PowerPoint.

claims.claim: Licence assignment controls which user accounts hold the Copilot entitlement the roadmap requires, rather than configuring this feature.
claims.quote: The following plans are eligible prerequisite licenses for Microsoft Copilot. After you purchase licenses, assign the licenses to users in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

claims.claim: No admin switch specific to this Copilot in PowerPoint rollout is documented, leaving licence assignment as the stated entitlement control.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Copilot in PowerPoint GCC government clouds default enabled admin disable switch policy Microsoft Graph'; 'Copilot in PowerPoint admin switch Graph'; 'PowerPoint Copilot policy edit disable'. Read Copilot settings, requirements, privacy and Chat management; no feature-specific switch found.
claims.fix: Replace the summary sentence 'No admin switch for it is documented; the licence is the control.' with 'No feature-specific admin switch is documented; licence assignment controls entitlement.' The cited privacy page documents broader connected-experience controls affecting PowerPoint, so avoid implying licence assignment is the only possible availability control.

claims.claim: The cited Copilot settings page lists no setting named for Copilot in PowerPoint.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Copilot in PowerPoint admin switch Graph'; read Configure Microsoft Copilot settings in the Microsoft 365 admin center in full. Its user access, data access, actions, other settings and app-experience lists contain no PowerPoint-specific setting.
